tabs.title: Desktop
tabs.note: This window's own preferences. The terminal app has its own colour theme, under Appearance.

rows.label: Theme
rows.hint: Follow the system's light or dark mode, or pin one (Ctrl+Shift+L cycles; --theme overrides for one run)

rows.label: Home view
rows.hint: What the main column shows with nothing open: the overview of repos, or the board of lanes (Shift+K switches)

rows.label: Open on
rows.hint: What the window shows when it opens: its home view, or the orchestrator (its start form when there is none yet)

rows.label: Diff layout
rows.hint: How the Diff view lays out a repo that has no layout saved yet (--diff overrides for one run)

rows.label: Worktree base branch
rows.hint: Branch new worktrees start from; Enter types one (empty = origin's default)

rows.label: Sync settings over ssh
rows.hint: kete ssh / tunnel carry config.json and presets to the remote (config.local.json stays)

groups.title: Terminal app
groups.subtitle: Only the terminal app acts on these. They share its config file.

rows.label: Search Enter attaches
rows.hint: Enter in / search opens the session in the terminal (a red one always does)

rows.label: File editor
rows.hint: Editor f/b/F and ⌥click launch (NEBULA_EDITOR overrides)

rows.label: Finder closes on open
rows.hint: Opening a file closes f/F, so quitting the editor is one Esc

rows.label: Open on the orchestrator
rows.hint: Start on the orchestrator's view (F10) when there is one: auto = only in a narrow terminal, always, or never

rows.label: Idle session timeout
rows.hint: Kill idle sessions in unviewed worktrees (busy ones spared; off disables)

rows.label: Warm spare agent
rows.hint: Boot a spare CLI in the selected worktree for instant creates (a peer in /list-agents)

rows.label: Prewarm dead sessions
rows.hint: Boot a worktree's dead sessions while the cursor rests on it, so attaching is instant

rows.label: Done sound
rows.hint: Ding when a turn finishes: off, the terminal bell, or a macOS system sound

rows.label: Feedback sound
rows.hint: Ring, and notify an unfocused window, when a turn stops to ask you (off silences both)

rows.label: Preset text
rows.hint: Where a new agent preset's text goes: a prefix before the task, a postfix after it, or both (its Text row can change one)

rows.label: Delete emptied worktree
rows.hint: Deleting a worktree's last session or terminal deletes the worktree with it, no question asked (off = that delete's confirm asks first)

rows.label: Auto-clean merged worktrees
rows.hint: When a linked worktree's PR is safely detected as merged, archive idle sessions and remove the worktree (root/default/base branches are never touched)

rows.label: Show all worktrees
rows.hint: Every worktree gets a band on the grid and a row in the window's overview, even an empty one (d deletes it); deleting a last card keeps the worktree unless Delete emptied worktree is on

rows.label: Confirm on archive
rows.hint: a and the card menu's Archive ask before archiving a session (off archives at once; u brings it back)

rows.label: Account spread
rows.hint: Which profile a new session takes when none is picked: manual = the harness's default; failover = the default until its 5h or weekly use reaches the threshold, then the next enabled one; least_used = the enabled one with the least use

rows.label: Failover at
rows.hint: Percent of an account's 5h or weekly limit at which failover moves to the next enabled profile

rows.label: Usage status line
rows.hint: Claude sessions get kete's status line, which reads plan usage and context for the accounts list (your own statusLine still runs and prints; off = only the on-screen usage notice)

groups.title: Terminal app
groups.subtitle: Only the terminal app acts on these. They share its config file.

rows.label: Confirm drag move
rows.hint: A session card dropped on another worktree or project tab asks before it moves (off = the drop moves it at once; m's picker never asks)

groups.title: Terminal app
groups.subtitle: Only the terminal app acts on these. They share its config file.

rows.label: Color theme
rows.hint: Colors across the grid, overlays, previews and diffs. one-dark / one-light paint their own canvas; auto follows the OS light or dark; vscode reads the theme VS Code is set to

rows.label: File icons
rows.hint: Per-file-type icons where files are listed: nerd (Nerd Font glyphs), ascii (a two-letter tag), off; auto picks nerd when the Windows Terminal profile's font is a Nerd Font (kete setup terminal installs one)

rows.label: Animations
rows.hint: Status text sweep and splash motion (off = fewer repaints)

rows.label: Black background
rows.hint: Paint the window pure black instead of the terminal's own background (off keeps the terminal's, transparency included)

rows.label: Session pane
rows.hint: Where the session under the cursor is read: beside the cards on the right, or under them

rows.label: Worktree layout
rows.hint: Each worktree as a row of cards, a compact list, or a thread of prompts

rows.label: Inline graphics
rows.hint: Render images and Mermaid diagrams inline: auto, protocol names, halfblocks, or off

rows.label: Expand all worktrees
rows.hint: Show every worktree's sessions and terminals at once, with no Tab to open one (off = one worktree opens at a time, with Tab)

rows.label: Kanban
rows.hint: Lay the grid out as lanes by status (Needs input, Running, Unseen, Done, PR open) instead of a band per worktree (⇧K)

rows.label: Kanban scope
rows.hint: Whose sessions the kanban lanes hold: the project on screen, or every project (Tab on the board)

rows.label: Card issue number
rows.hint: Show the #number of the GitHub issue a session was started from on its card; click it to open the issue

rows.label: Highlight current card
rows.hint: Wash the cursor's card faintly in its status color, breathing while it runs, asks or waits unread, and keep it lit while you type in its pane (off = the plain gray fill)

rows.label: Card marks
rows.hint: Show or hide the ▶ (run terminal) and ❯ (shell) before a terminal card's name and the › before a session card's prompt

rows.label: Draft pull requests
rows.hint: Show or hide draft pull requests in / search; checkouts always stay

rows.label: Diff layout
rows.hint: How the g diff viewer lays a diff out: side by side, inline with two line-number gutters, or the new text alone (Ctrl+s in the viewer)

rows.label: Diff context
rows.hint: The unchanged lines around a change: three each side with the rest folded, or the whole file (Ctrl+o in the viewer)

rows.label: Show commit graph
rows.hint: Add the read-only git commit graph under the g diff view's changed files

rows.label: Agent
rows.hint: Harness the quick prompt hotkey launches, with that kind's model/effort

rows.label: Follow new
rows.hint: Move the cursor onto the new session's card, the grid scrolled to it, without entering it (off = stay on the card you're on)

rows.label: New worktree
rows.hint: Each new session's box starts on a fresh worktree (off = the project's root branch; ^N flips one box)

rows.label: Hide missing CLIs
rows.hint: List only harnesses found on PATH in the New session picker (daemon still checks at launch)

rows.label: Enabled
rows.hint: Offer Claude in the New session picker (off hides it; existing sessions keep running)

rows.label: Model
rows.hint: Default model for new Claude sessions; rows follow Claude's availableModels or config.json claude_models

rows.label: Effort
rows.hint: Default reasoning effort (--effort) for new Claude sessions

rows.label: Enabled
rows.hint: Offer Codex in the New session picker (off hides it; existing sessions keep running)

rows.label: Model
rows.hint: Default model for new Codex sessions (default = CLI's pick)

rows.label: Effort
rows.hint: Default reasoning effort (-c model_reasoning_effort=) for new Codex sessions

rows.label: Enabled
rows.hint: Offer Cursor in the New session picker (off hides it; existing sessions keep running)

rows.label: Model
rows.hint: Default model family for new Cursor sessions; rows follow cursor-agent --list-models

rows.label: Effort
rows.hint: Effort (and -fast) variant of the chosen Cursor model; n/a while it is default or auto

rows.label: Enabled
rows.hint: Offer Pi in the New session picker (off hides it; existing sessions keep running)

rows.label: Model
rows.hint: Default model for new Pi sessions (default = CLI's pick)

rows.label: Effort
rows.hint: Default reasoning effort (--thinking) for new Pi sessions

rows.label: Enabled
rows.hint: Offer Muse in the New session picker (off hides it; existing sessions keep running)

rows.label: Model
rows.hint: Default model for new Muse sessions (default = CLI's pick)

rows.label: Effort
rows.hint: Reserved until the Muse CLI documents a reasoning flag (default = unset)

rows.label: Enabled
rows.hint: Offer Grok Build in the New session picker (off hides it; existing sessions keep running)

rows.label: Model
rows.hint: Default model for new Grok Build sessions (default = CLI's pick)

rows.label: Effort
rows.hint: Default reasoning effort (--reasoning-effort) for new Grok Build sessions

rows.label: Enabled
rows.hint: Offer OpenCode in the New session picker (off hides it; existing sessions keep running)

rows.label: Model
rows.hint: Default model for new OpenCode sessions (default = CLI's pick)

rows.label: Enabled
rows.hint: Offer Copilot in the New session picker (off hides it; existing sessions keep running)

rows.label: Model
rows.hint: Default model for new Copilot sessions (default = CLI's pick)

rows.label: Effort
rows.hint: Default reasoning effort (--reasoning-effort) for new Copilot sessions

groups.title: Terminal app
groups.subtitle: Only the terminal app acts on these. They share its config file.

rows.label: Focus
rows.hint: Enter the new session's terminal on launch (off = just select its row)

tabs.title: Project
tabs.note: Per repo. Empty commands fall back to the checkout's .kete.json.

rows.label: Run command
rows.hint: Shell line a menu's Run starts in this project's worktrees (empty = its .kete.json "run")

rows.label: Open command
rows.hint: Shell line ⇧Enter / ⇧O runs to open a worktree of this project, e.g. open http://localhost:3000 (empty = its .kete.json "open")

rows.label: Preview browser
rows.hint: The browser the terminal app's w opens this project's dev server in first (it remembers the last pick)

rows.label: Run command
rows.hint: Shell line a menu's Run starts in this project's worktrees (empty = its .kete.json "run")

rows.label: Open command
rows.hint: Shell line ⇧Enter / ⇧O runs to open a worktree of this project, e.g. open http://localhost:3000 (empty = its .kete.json "open")

rows.label: Preview browser
rows.hint: The browser the terminal app's w opens this project's dev server in first (it remembers the last pick)

groups.title: Terminal app
groups.subtitle: Only the terminal app acts on these. They share its config file.

rows.label: Remember harness
rows.hint: A harness (and model) picked for a session becomes the Agents tab default the next launch starts on

tabs.title: Hotkeys
tabs.note: This window's keys first: press a chord to bind one, or put it back. Then the terminal app's, read-only here: rebind those in its Settings, Hotkeys tab. A running terminal app picks up changes when it next starts.

hotkeys.label: Open / fold checkout
hotkeys.hint: Open every card of the checkout under the cursor in place, or fold it back to one row: one checkout open at a time

hotkeys.label: Focus left
hotkeys.hint: Step to the card on the left, stopping at the row's first

hotkeys.label: Focus right
hotkeys.hint: Step to the card on the right, stopping at the row's last

hotkeys.label: Move down
hotkeys.hint: Move the cursor down a row of cards; twice from the project tabs, into the one under their cursor

hotkeys.label: Move up
hotkeys.hint: Move the cursor up a row of cards, stopping at the first; twice there, up to the project tabs

hotkeys.label: Half page down
hotkeys.hint: Jump the cursor down two rows of cards, stopping at the last

hotkeys.label: Half page up
hotkeys.hint: Jump the cursor up two rows of cards, stopping at the first

hotkeys.label: Open / attach
hotkeys.hint: Into the pane on the card under the cursor, or lock the pane's input

hotkeys.label: Fuzzy jump
hotkeys.hint: Search every project, worktree and session at once

hotkeys.label: Command palette
hotkeys.hint: Search every project, worktree, session and pull request, and every action by its name: Enter jumps to the row or runs the action

hotkeys.label: Back
hotkeys.hint: Go back to the place the grid was on before (its project tab, the card under the cursor, full-screen or not), as the header's ‹ does. < is bound beside ⌥←, which needs Option as Meta on a Mac

hotkeys.label: Forward
hotkeys.hint: Go forward again after a back, as the header's › does. > is bound beside ⌥→, which needs Option as Meta on a Mac

hotkeys.label: Next session needing you
hotkeys.hint: Jump to the next session in the palette's attention order (needs feedback, running, unseen, then recency) in any project, wrapping

hotkeys.label: Prev session needing you
hotkeys.hint: The same walk backwards: the session before this one in the palette's attention order, wrapping at the top

hotkeys.label: Next project tab
hotkeys.hint: Open the project on the tab to the right of this one in the header, stopping at the last

hotkeys.label: Prev project tab
hotkeys.hint: Open the project on the tab to the left, stopping at the first

hotkeys.label: Project tab 1
hotkeys.hint: Open the project on that tab of the header, counting from the left (⌘N only in emulators that send ⌘)

hotkeys.label: Project tab 2
hotkeys.hint: Open the project on that tab of the header, counting from the left (⌘N only in emulators that send ⌘)

hotkeys.label: Project tab 3
hotkeys.hint: Open the project on that tab of the header, counting from the left (⌘N only in emulators that send ⌘)

hotkeys.label: Project tab 4
hotkeys.hint: Open the project on that tab of the header, counting from the left (⌘N only in emulators that send ⌘)

hotkeys.label: Project tab 5
hotkeys.hint: Open the project on that tab of the header, counting from the left (⌘N only in emulators that send ⌘)

hotkeys.label: Project tab 6
hotkeys.hint: Open the project on that tab of the header, counting from the left (⌘N only in emulators that send ⌘)

hotkeys.label: Project tab 7
hotkeys.hint: Open the project on that tab of the header, counting from the left (⌘N only in emulators that send ⌘)

hotkeys.label: Project tab 8
hotkeys.hint: Open the project on that tab of the header, counting from the left (⌘N only in emulators that send ⌘)

hotkeys.label: Project tab 9
hotkeys.hint: Open the project on that tab of the header, counting from the left (⌘N only in emulators that send ⌘)

hotkeys.label: Close project tab
hotkeys.hint: Drop this project's tab from the header and open the tab beside it. Nothing is deleted: + opens it again

hotkeys.label: Switch project
hotkeys.hint: Drop the list of every project under the + in the header: type to narrow it, Enter or a click opens one. + is the header's own button and arrives in every terminal and in kete browser; ⌘P does the same from inside the pane, where the terminal sends ⌘ at all (Ghostty/kitty do, Terminal.app and the browser never do)

hotkeys.label: Open a folder as a project
hotkeys.hint: Open a folder as a project in kete, from anywhere; ⇧O opens a checkout outside it, in your editor

hotkeys.label: New session
hotkeys.hint: Pick the harness first (→ drills into its model and effort), then the quick prompt opens set to it, in the checkout under the cursor; on the first-run splash, add a project

hotkeys.label: New worktree
hotkeys.hint: Cut a new worktree in the selected or shown project

hotkeys.label: Run / stop the run command
hotkeys.hint: Start the checkout's run command (the project's Run setting, else its .kete.json run), or stop it while it runs

hotkeys.label: Delete worktree
hotkeys.hint: Delete the selected linked worktree's folder, behind a confirmation; its branch stays

hotkeys.label: Remove project
hotkeys.hint: Take the project off the list, behind a confirmation: nothing on disk is touched

hotkeys.label: Git diff
hotkeys.hint: Open the diff viewer for the checkout under the cursor, or, with the pane reading a pull request, that pull request's diff

hotkeys.label: Open repo in browser
hotkeys.hint: Send the selected repo's git remote (GitHub, GitLab, …) to your browser

hotkeys.label: Open pull request in browser
hotkeys.hint: Send the pull request of the session card under the cursor (its checkout's branch) to your browser, as a click on the card's #42 line does. v lists the pull requests in kete; ⇧V goes to GitHub

hotkeys.label: Open issue in browser
hotkeys.hint: Send the GitHub issue the session card under the cursor was started from to your browser. i lists the issues in kete; ⇧I goes to GitHub

hotkeys.label: Reload from GitHub
hotkeys.hint: Ask GitHub again now for the project's open pull requests and issues, the selected worktree's PR and the one the pane is reading

hotkeys.label: Comment on pull request
hotkeys.hint: Open a box to type a comment and post it through gh on the card's pull request (the one ⇧V opens) or, with the pane reading a pull request (a / jump lands on one), on that one

hotkeys.label: GitHub issues
hotkeys.hint: List the project's open issues; Enter prompts an agent on one, ⇧Tab launches a preset on it

hotkeys.label: GitHub pull requests
hotkeys.hint: List the project's open pull requests; Enter prompts a PR session on one, ⇧Tab launches a preset on it, Tab picks a harness

hotkeys.label: Switch root branch
hotkeys.hint: Fuzzy-pick a branch or remote for the project's root checkout; uncommitted changes get stash / bring / commit / discard

hotkeys.label: Azure DevOps
hotkeys.hint: On a project whose remote is on Azure DevOps (the header shows an ado button): your sprint's tasks, the active pull requests and the branches. Enter opens a task or pull request in the browser and checks a branch out in a worktree; s twice starts a task (branch, worktree, agent)

hotkeys.label: Open checkout in editor
hotkeys.hint: Open the selected checkout outside kete, usually in your editor: its project's Open command (Settings → Project), else .kete.json "open", e.g. open http://localhost:3000 (⇧Enter needs the kitty protocol; ⇧O arrives everywhere; ⌥Enter is the ESC CR that VS Code's Shift+Enter setup sends and tmux passes through)

hotkeys.label: Open localhost in a browser
hotkeys.hint: Open the selected worktree's dev server (http://localhost:<port>, the port its sessions listen on) in a browser picked from Chrome, Edge, Firefox or the system default; the pick is remembered per project

hotkeys.label: Screenshot localhost
hotkeys.hint: Take a headless Edge or Chrome screenshot (1280×800) of the selected worktree's dev server and show it in the image view

hotkeys.label: New shell terminal
hotkeys.hint: Spawn a plain shell inside kete, in the selected worktree's directory; ⇧T opens one outside it, in a Ghostty tab

hotkeys.label: Terminal in a Ghostty tab
hotkeys.hint: Open a new Ghostty tab in the selected worktree's directory: t's terminal, outside kete; does nothing without Ghostty.app

hotkeys.label: Rename
hotkeys.hint: Rename the session under the cursor (the checkout's run command is the menu's Run / Stop)

hotkeys.label: Archive session
hotkeys.hint: Archive the selected agent (its PTY is released)

hotkeys.label: Unarchive session
hotkeys.hint: Bring an archived agent back into the list

hotkeys.label: Show / hide archived
hotkeys.hint: Swap the grid between the live sessions and the archived ones

hotkeys.label: Delete selected
hotkeys.hint: Remove the selected row, behind a confirmation. With the PROJECT TABS holding the keys, close the tab under their cursor, behind the same kind of confirmation: x closes it outright. On a Mac keyboard Del is fn+⌫

hotkeys.label: Delete all sessions
hotkeys.hint: Remove every session listed for the checkout under the cursor, behind a confirmation

hotkeys.label: Restart the agent
hotkeys.hint: Restart the selected session's agent, resuming its conversation

hotkeys.label: Make or unpin the orchestrator
hotkeys.hint: Pin the selected session as the machine's orchestrator, or unpin it when it is one

hotkeys.label: Move to another account
hotkeys.hint: Restart the selected session fresh on another account, picked from a list (its conversation stays behind)

hotkeys.label: Agent presets
hotkeys.hint: Saved launch presets (CLI, model, effort, prefix/postfix) for the checkout under the cursor; Enter asks for an optional task, or skips it; from the pull requests list, a PR session in that branch's worktree

hotkeys.label: Quick prompt
hotkeys.hint: Type a prompt; Enter starts an agent on it (Settings > Agents picks which)

hotkeys.label: Follow-up prompt
hotkeys.hint: Open a box over the grid for the selected session's next turn, sent to the running agent on Enter; the pane stays as it is

hotkeys.label: Duplicate session
hotkeys.hint: Open the quick prompt set to launch what the selected card runs (the same harness, model, effort and worktree) so only the task is left to type. p opens the box on the defaults; ⇧P on the card

hotkeys.label: Move session
hotkeys.hint: Pick another worktree, of this project or another, for the selected session; it resumes there, after its current turn when it is mid-turn. Dragging the card onto another band or project tab does the same

hotkeys.label: Move item up
hotkeys.hint: Move the card under the cursor one place earlier in its band (on the board, among its worktree's cards in its lane), or on a band with no card to be on (empty or folded) that band, or with the project tabs holding the keys the tab under their cursor one place left; the menus' Move up and dragging do the same. ⌥↑ needs Option as Meta on a Mac; ⇧↑ is bound beside it

hotkeys.label: Move item down
hotkeys.hint: Move the card under the cursor one place later in its band (on the board, in its lane), or the project tab under the header's cursor one place right; the menus' Move down and dragging do the same

hotkeys.label: Subagents and session tree
hotkeys.hint: The project's sessions as a tree, each session under the one that started it and the subagents running inside it under that; Enter opens the session, → and ← open and fold, Tab every project. A card's ⑂ chip opens it on that session

hotkeys.label: Find file
hotkeys.hint: Fuzzy file finder for the selected worktree

hotkeys.label: Find in files
hotkeys.hint: git grep across the selected worktree

hotkeys.label: File tree browser
hotkeys.hint: Browse the worktree's files with a preview pane

hotkeys.label: Unlock terminal input
hotkeys.hint: Leave the locked pane and go back to the card (^q always works; ^⇧H needs the kitty protocol)

hotkeys.label: Launcher session pane
hotkeys.hint: Fold the pane under the cards away (which also unselects the card it was reading) or bring it back. From inside the pane the ctrl chords take two presses: the first hands the keys back to the card, the second folds the pane. ^` and ^~ need the kitty protocol; ~ is bound alongside them, the shift of the ` that walks the pane's tabs

hotkeys.label: Kanban board
hotkeys.hint: Lay the grid out as lanes by status (Needs you, Running, Unread, Done, PR open) or back to a band per worktree; the Overview | Board toggle at the right of the grid's header does the same by click. On the board h/l walk the lanes, j/k the cards, Tab flips between this project and every project

hotkeys.label: Orchestrator view
hotkeys.hint: Toggle between the chat-first orchestrator view and the grid

hotkeys.label: Accounts and usage
hotkeys.hint: Every account (profiles, and each CLI's own login) with its 5h and weekly plan usage, resets and login; Space switches a profile on or off, d makes it its harness's default

hotkeys.label: Full-screen session
hotkeys.hint: Give the session in the pane the whole screen, or bring it back down beside the cards. From the cards it full-screens the one under the cursor. z is typed into a locked pane like any letter; ^f works from inside it too, where it is never forwarded to the agent. ^q and ^` also bring a full-screen session back down

hotkeys.label: Terminals in the pane
hotkeys.hint: Walk the cursor through the terminal cards of its checkout, one after another and back round to the first, the pane reads each

hotkeys.label: SSH hosts
hotkeys.hint: Connect to a saved ssh host (restarts kete over ssh)

hotkeys.label: Settings
hotkeys.hint: Open this settings overlay (^, needs the kitty protocol; s arrives everywhere)

hotkeys.label: Memory usage
hotkeys.hint: RAM used by kete and every live agent's process tree

hotkeys.label: Verbs for the selection
hotkeys.hint: What can be done to the card, band, tab or row under the cursor, each with its key: type to narrow, Enter runs one; the last row is every key

hotkeys.label: Help
hotkeys.hint: Toggle the keyboard help overlay: every key (? lists the selection's verbs, with this one row down)

hotkeys.label: Quit kete
hotkeys.hint: Leave the TUI (sessions keep running in the daemon)
